turns.text: Of course! Classical conditioning would still apply on such a planet. A bird could learn to associate a specific sound (like a signal from its trainer) with food. Over time, just hearing the sound would make the bird salivate, even without the food present initially. The key is the consistent pairing of the sound and the food reward.
